abilities.title_en: Starts the fight with 6 Shield Buffs <s>each capping damage from one attack to {{var_1}} of the opponent's Attack Rating. </s>which are removed each time Rhinox is hit by a Basic or Heavy Melee Attack.

abilities.desc_en: While Rhinox's Shield is active, powerful enemy attacks cannot deal more than {{var_2}} of the opponent's Attack Rating in a single hit.

Overclock
Shield Buffs are more effective, but also more volatile.

+approximately {{var_17}} per level
